name: The Rocks Pirates
description: The most dangerous crew of their age: a ship full of future legends who hated each other almost as much as they hated the world.
goal: Rule the world, by way of the Holy Land.

name: The Roger Pirates
description: Gol D. Roger's crew, never large, never beaten for long, and in the end the only crew to sail the whole Grand Line.
goal: Reach the end of the Grand Line.

name: The Golden Lion Pirates
description: The great fleet of Shiki, the Golden Lion: hundreds of ships under one flying flagship.
goal: Rule the seas and break the Government.

name: The Whitebeard Pirates
description: Edward Newgate's family of sons: sixteen divisions, dozens of allied crews, and a captain who wanted nothing in the world but family.
goal: Family, and a flag that protects it.

name: The Big Mom Pirates
description: Charlotte Linlin's family crew, most of them her children, with an island nation of sweets to defend and a mother to feed.
goal: A country where every race lives at the same height, and dessert.

name: The Beasts Pirates
description: Kaido's army of brawlers and artificial-fruit beasts, the strongest single crew in the world by the end of the era.
goal: A war big enough to end the world, and a death worth having.

name: The Donquixote Pirates
description: A family of outcasts gathered around a fallen World Noble boy who grew up to be a king of the underworld.
goal: Revenge on the world that threw him out.

name: The Red Hair Pirates
description: Shanks's crew: hard-drinking, slow to anger, and by the end of the era one of the four great powers of the sea.
goal: Keep the peace between the powers, and enjoy the party.

name: The Kuja Pirates
description: The warrior women of Amazon Lily, who sail out to plunder and come home to a kingdom no man may enter.

name: The Sun Pirates
description: Escaped slaves, fish-men and merfolk, who burned the mark of slavery off their skin by painting a sun over it.
goal: Freedom, and never to be owned again.

name: The Arlong Pirates
description: Arlong's fish-man crew, who took the lesson of the Sun Pirates to be that humans should be ruled.
goal: An empire of fish-men in the East Blue.

name: The Heart Pirates
description: A submarine crew from the North Blue under a surgeon with a grudge.

name: The Straw Hat Pirates
description: A boy with a straw hat and a dream, and the handful of misfits who followed him into every fight in the world.
goal: The One Piece, and every dream aboard.

name: The Blackbeard Pirates
description: Marshall D. Teach's crew of the worst of the worst, gathered for a plan decades in the making.

name: The Test Crew
description: Dev fixture crew for the canon tests.
